name: Cetus CLMM
description: Cetus is a pioneer DEX and concentrated liquidity protocol focusing on Move-based ecosystems like Aptos and Sui. It works as a crucial part of the ecosystem infrastructure to satisfy the comprehensive needs of traders, LPs, upper applications and an increasing DeFi population.

raises.name: Cetus
raises.sector: DEX and concentrated liquidity protocol built on Sui and Aptos

hacks.name: Cetus CLMM
hacks.description: Cetus CLMM on Sui suffered a math error in its checked_shlw function where an incorrect overflow threshold (0xffffffffffffffff << 192 instead of 1 << 192) allowed attackers to craft positions with phantom liquidity. Using flashloans to manipulate prices and create tight tick ranges, attackers minted enormous liquidity while depositing minimal real tokens, then withdrew actual reserves.
